comparator.name: Pedagogical Sciences
comparator.route: Pedagogische Wetenschappen — first-listed Orthopedagogiek specialization, ordinary non-abroad route
comparator.sourceNotes: The university’s current prospective year pages list 60+60+60=180 EC, but explicitly say that the 2026–27 overview may change. Year one has 60 EC compulsory study. Year two has 44 EC common courses, 8 EC in one formal specialization and 8 EC genuinely free choice. Year three has 22 EC common courses, 8 EC of specialization-specific professional skills, a 4-EC specialization course, 16 EC genuinely free choice and a required 10-EC bachelor thesis. No year-two elective menu or third-year Young in Motion minor is universally required. The generic registry target does not name one of four specializations, so the first-listed Orthopedagogiek route is a neutral official-order instance, with its matched professional-skills option; the other three are not combined. Year pages show concurrent 2026–27 cohorts, not a guaranteed single-entrant three-year schedule. Zero-credit RADAr is excluded from 180 EC. Radboud’s supervised Kennis in praktijk and Beroepsvaardigheden are credit-bearing and remain distinct from UCR classroom-contact and general psychology courses.

alternatives.label: Child development, learning and youth support
alternatives.concept: A UCR programme combines developmental psychology, cognition, language, social context, youth vulnerability, psychological assessment and empirical methods to study children’s development and support. It is an academic response through related fields. UCR does not offer Radboud’s dedicated pedagogy and orthopedagogy sequence, professional placements or required pedagogical-sciences thesis.
alternatives.labelReason: The scheduled courses directly address lifespan development, cognition, psychological difficulties, child-linked communication and research; the label does not imply clinical qualification or a dedicated pedagogy curriculum.
progression: HCBGATE102 precedes all scheduled cognition and psychology courses that formally require it, and HCBGATE101 precedes Human Physiology. All 24 distinct courses are offered in assigned Fall 2026 through Spring 2029 terms, with at least six 300-level courses.

candidates.label: Onderwijs: learning, teaching and educational improvement
candidates.reason: UCR has school-linked rhetoric and learning psychology but no curriculum in instruction design, school quality assessment or classroom-based educational science from which to build a separate 24-course education programme.

candidates.label: Young in Motion: children’s movement and health
candidates.reason: UCR covers perception, action and physiology but lacks child movement, physical activity pedagogy and intervention coursework for a substantively distinct 24-course option.

routeSelection.route: Pedagogische Wetenschappen — first-listed Orthopedagogiek specialization, ordinary non-abroad route
routeSelection.basis: The generic bachelor requires a second-year and third-year specialization but designates no default. The first official listed Orthopedagogiek route is selected without regard to UCR fit; its year-three professional-skills and intervention choices are matched to that route. The ordinary free-choice space remains open.

selection.assessment: The first programme incorporates the available developmental, orthopedagogical, family/social and research courses. A Pedagogiek or Onderzoek alternative would mainly rearrange these same courses and lack the required four-course substantive change. The separate Onderwijs and Young in Motion directions lack enough subject-specific UCR teaching to yield defensible distinct programmes.

notes.text: Radboud combines child development, pedagogy, specialist orthopedagogical assessment, guided practice in educational or care settings and a pedagogical-sciences thesis. UCR can study development, cognition, psychology, sociology and research, including one primary-school communication project. It does not provide supervised pedagogical placements, dedicated educational science and orthopedagogy, or professional diagnostic qualification.
